title: Thick Chocolate Milkshake with Whipped Cream
summary: Chocolate ice cream, very cold milk and chocolate syrup are blended in short bursts until thick and smooth, poured into frozen glasses and topped with softly whipped cream.

ingredients.note: plus extra for the glasses, optional

steps.title: Chill the glasses
steps.text: Freeze the glasses for 10 minutes so the shake stays thick.

steps.title: Whip the cream
steps.text: Whisk the cream with the icing sugar to soft peaks and keep it cold.

steps.title: Decorate
steps.text: Drizzle a little chocolate syrup inside the glasses if you like.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the ice cream, milk and syrup in short bursts for 15-20 seconds, just until smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour into the glasses, top with whipped cream and drink straight away.

tips: Let the ice cream soften for 5 minutes so it blends without extra milk.
Short bursts keep the shake thick; long blending warms it.
Use a wide straw: a proper shake is thick.
storage: Best drunk immediately. It does not keep; leftover shake can be frozen in ice-lolly moulds. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
